text:
Jordan P.: Noticed another onboarding hit: sample Go generator behavior around cancellation is confusing. Users cancel ctx but Next() keeps blocking. We should document patterns and consider API improvements.

Jordan P.: Tiny repro used by support:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
// read one token
_, _ = iter.Next()
cancel()
// Next() sometimes blocks or eventually returns after server finishes
```

Maya L.: The root cause seems to be the transport retry + auth refresh. When the canceled request races with a token refresh, the transport restarts the stream and leaves the old reader stuck on Read().

Theo R.: Proposal ideas: (A) Make iterator implement io.Closer and guarantee Close cancels the internal http.Request context and causes in-flight Next() to return context.Canceled quickly. (B) Add NextWithCtx(ctx) so callers can pass a per-call timeout/cancel instead of relying only on the parent ctx. (C) Add per-call meta `Retry: "none"` or `NoStreamRetry:true` so transport won't attempt to retry streaming calls by default.

Maya L.: I like Close + explicit NoStreamRetry as the immediate fix. NextWithCtx is nice but bigger API change. Also add a small sample snippet and a Quickstart note: show both patterns. Eg:
```go
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer iter.Close()
for {
  select {
  case <-ctx.Done():
    iter.Close()
    return
  default:
    tok, err := iter.Next()
    if err != nil { break }
    fmt.Println(tok.Text)
  }
}
```

Jordan P.: Also recommend adding a small bounded buffer for tokens inside the iterator to avoid unbounded memory if user doesn't read fast, and expose that as an option `BufferTokens: 64`. That helps when apps cancel late and prevents retained memory.

Theo R.: I'll prototype Close() and NoStreamRetry flag. Maya, can you add the doc snippets to Quickstart? Jordan, can you open a ticket for buffer/backpressure?

Maya L.: Yep, will add doc PR.

Jordan P.: Filed issue #2301 for backpressure knobs and sample guidance.

infra-bot: Created issue #2300: "go-sdk: generator cancel semantics + stream retry policy" and linked branch.

Theo R.: I'll land a small unit test asserting Next() returns within 100ms after Close() and a CI goroutine-leak check.

Maya L.: Thanks — this should cut down the onboarding support threads.

Jordan P.: Great, thanks all.
